=== FILE: log_serializer.py ===
"""System Log TSV Serializer TSV line serializer."""
from typing import List
from tsv_helper import parse_tsv_line, count_tsv_fields
from tsv_model import create_record

def _escape_tsv_cell(val: str) -> str:
    """Escape control characters for TSV per H10."""
    val = val.replace('\\', '\\\\')
    val = val.replace('"', '\\"')
    val = val.replace('\t', '\\t')
    val = val.replace('\n', '\\n')
    return val

def serialize_log_line(level: str, msg: str, target: str) -> str:
    rec = create_record(level, msg, target)
    esc_level = _escape_tsv_cell(rec.level)
    esc_msg = _escape_tsv_cell(rec.message)
    esc_target = _escape_tsv_cell(rec.target)
    return f"{esc_level}\t{esc_msg}\t{esc_target}"

def validate_line(line: str) -> bool:
    return count_tsv_fields(line) == 3
=== END ===
